name: Omicron - AML Alert Triage Steel Thread
title: Omicron - AML Alert Triage Steel Thread
description: CALM architecture for the Omicron Track 2 submission: the FINOS AI Steel Thread pipeline applied to AML alert triage (AIGF UC-4). Fluxnova orchestrates a deterministic pre-screen, an advisory LLM triage step, and a deterministic policy gate that bounds agent non-determinism; AIGF mi-1/4/5/11 controls and FINOS Common Cloud Controls (CCC) GenAI controls are attached to the components that enforce them.

metadata.note: The policy gate reads only rule-engine output (score) and a bounded agent recommendation; the agent can add human oversight but never remove it. Deterministic controls are unit-tested as invariants (see AfcRuleEngineTest).

nodes.name: Launch UI (AML Alert Triage)
nodes.description: Submits alerts, shows rule hits, agent recommendation, and the deterministic gate decision

nodes.name: AFC REST API
nodes.description: Starts AfcInvestigation_AI instances, exposes status, human task completion, and the evidence PDF

human-feedback-loop.description: FINOS AIGF mi-11: compliance officer completes UserTask_AfcComplianceReview with a decision, rationale, and four-eyes reviewer.

config.name: Human Feedback Loop for AI Systems
config.description: Human review task for mandatory-review and review-with-advisory paths (FINOS AIGF mi-11).

acceptance-testing.description: FINOS AIGF mi-5: deterministic acceptance invariants (high-risk alerts never auto-close; agent cannot downgrade oversight).

config.name: System Acceptance Testing
config.description: AfcRuleEngineTest asserts policy monotonicity across agent recommendations.

nodes.name: Fluxnova BPM Engine
nodes.description: Orchestrates AfcInvestigation_AI: pre-screen, LLM triage, policy gate, human task, finalize

ai-system-observability.description: FINOS AIGF mi-4: token usage, audit metadata, and traces recorded per instance.

config.name: AI System Observability
config.description: Records prompt/completion token counts and gate decisions in process variables and evidence pack.

model-version-pinning.description: FINOS CCC GenAI CN07: the inference endpoint and model identifier are pinned per deployment and recorded in the evidence pack.

config.name: Model Version Pinning
config.description: Base URL and model name are fixed at deployment; evidence records the active model.

nodes.name: Deterministic Rule Engine
nodes.description: Pure, LLM-free scoring: structuring, high-risk jurisdiction, velocity, sanctions near-match, PEP, round amounts

deterministic-policy.description: Policy AFC-3.2: score >= 70 mandatory review; >= 40 review with advisory; below, auto-close only when the agent agrees.

config.name: Quality Control and Red Teaming
config.description: Deterministic policy invariants are exercised by unit tests and QA sampling of auto-closed alerts.

nodes.name: LLM Endpoint (OpenAI-compatible)
nodes.description: Local llama.cpp server (or hosted provider) used for advisory triage only

ai-data-leakage-prevention.description: FINOS AIGF mi-1: long identifiers are redacted before the alert leaves the process; redaction count is recorded in the evidence pack.

config.name: AI Data Leakage Prevention
config.description: AfcLlmTriageService redacts identifiers at the LLM egress boundary (FINOS AIGF mi-1).

config.name: Model Input Filtering and Sanitisation
config.description: Alert payload is redacted and validated before being passed to the GenAI model.

config.name: Model Output Filtering and Sanitisation
config.description: Model output is parsed strictly; malformed or unrecognised output degrades to escalation.

nodes.name: Compliance Officer
nodes.description: Reviews mandatory or advisory alerts, records decision and rationale (four-eyes)

nodes.name: Evidence Store
nodes.description: Per-instance evidence PDF: rule hits, agent rationale, gate decision, policy citation, control coverage

nodes.name: CALM Hub
nodes.description: Stores and serves CALM architectures and control requirements

nodes.name: FINOS Common Cloud Controls - GenAI catalog
nodes.description: CCC.GenAI.CN01..CN08 controls mapped to AIGF threats upstream

relationships.description: AML alert triage ecosystem: UI, API, Fluxnova engine, rule engine, LLM endpoint, evidence store
Compliance operations submits alerts through the Launch UI
Compliance officer completes human review tasks through the API
AFC API starts AfcInvestigation_AI instances on the Fluxnova engine
Pre-screen delegate invokes the deterministic rule engine
Triage delegate calls the LLM endpoint with a redacted payload
Evidence endpoint renders the per-instance governance pack
CALM Hub stores this architecture and the AIGF control requirements
CCC GenAI controls are attached to the LLM endpoint, rule engine, and orchestration nodes
